candidates.change_summary: Replace `owner = _newOwner;` with `owner = address(0);` so ownership is set to zero address instead of the provided new owner.
Replace `owner = _newOwner;` with `owner = msg.sender;` so owner is always set to caller instead of the argument.
Replace `owner = _newOwner;` with `owner = address(this);` so owner becomes the contract itself.
Delete the statement `owner = _newOwner;` so ownership never changes after the call.
Remove the `onlyOwner` modifier from `transferOwnership` so anyone can change the owner.
Replace `require(msg.sender == owner);` with `require(msg.sender != owner);` so only non-owner can call, reversing access control.
Delete the `require` statement so anyone can pass the modifier.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from the owned function.
Remove the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier.
Replace msg.sender == owner with true in the require statement.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership so anyone can call it and change the owner.
Change the assignment to set owner to a constant address instead of the parameter, so ownership never transfers to the intended new owner.
Change the require condition to always pass, allowing anyone to call transferOwnership regardless of sender.
